privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: HIVI Tecnologia is committed to protecting your personal data, in compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law 13.709/2018).

dataController.title: 1. Data Controller
dataController.content: HIVI Tecnologia — responsible for the processing of personal data collected on this website.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data Collected
dataCollected.content: We collect the following data when you use our contact form: full name, email address, phone (optional) and message. We also collect anonymized browsing data for website usage analysis.

purpose.title: 3. Processing Purpose
purpose.content: Your data is used exclusively to: respond to your contact, send information about our services (with consent) and improve our platform.

retention.title: 4. Data Retention
retention.content: We keep your data for the period necessary to fulfill the purpose of contact, or for the applicable legal period, after which it is securely deleted.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights (LGPD)
rights.content: You have the right to: confirm the existence of processing, access your data, correct incomplete data, request anonymization or deletion, revoke consent at any time.

security.title: 6. Security
security.content: We adopt technical and administrative measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, destruction or improper disclosure.

contact.title: 7. Data Protection Officer Contact
contact.content: To exercise your rights or clarify doubts, contact us by email:
